'''Keeta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. She worked with [[Gideon (spacer)|Gideon]], crewing aboard the ''[[Independent Class]]''. Keeta lost an eye when she and Gideon were ambushed by a [[Polydroxol]] in the employ of [[Trome (crime lord)|Boss Trome]].<ref name="SS" />
